System Study and Safety Audit for the purpose of eliminating the Risk of Accidents & Dangerous Occ 1. 905330028 NUMBER 1 urences at Surda Mine of M/s Hindustan Copper Li mited Important Note to Bidders: 1. L-1 will be decided on overall L-1 basis. Price will be firm, fixed and final during the entire exe cution period of contract. 2. The uploaded excel price breakup format is only for reference purpose for calculating the total contract value (including GST) which the bi dders are quoting in gem tender. 5. Bidder has to refer General Terms and Conditions (Clause No. 6. i) in GeM and quote their pric e inclusive of GST as per Price BOQ with grant total including GST Value. 6. The mobilization period shall be 07 days from the date of award of the work order. 7. Bidder shall refer "Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC" for all other terms and conditions as mentioned i n Annexure-III. Annexure-I (Scope of Work) SCOPE OF WORK: The scope of work under the said study is proposed to be as under: 1. Study and review of the systems deployed at the mines including mine ventilation and statutor y supervision. 2. Study and review of all statutory plans and sections maintained at the mines. 3. Study and review of method of work of mining, strata control and monitoring and the machiner ies/equipments deployed and maintenance thereof. 4. Study and review the winding systems deployed at the mines and maintenance thereof. 5. Identification of sources of danger in mines viz: inundation, fire, gas, explosion, premature coll apse of workings and air blast, explosives and blasting practices and consequent likely emerge

ncies. 6. Review & physical inspection of major operational activities like-Excavation, backfilling/stowin g, loading, hauling (transportation), dumping including ore stocking, dozing, grading, pumping & dewatering, maintenance, dust suppression, Conveyance vehicle, Ground movement, fall of p erson, material handling etc. 7. Review & physical inspection of fire-fighting system like fire hydrant, fire extinguisher, water/f oam monitor, automatic fire detection & sprinkling system in the mines. 8. Identify the existing fire & other hazards in some critical areas like workshop, all transfer point s, scrap yard, control room, penal room, transformer yard, crusher house, compressor room, M ain Mechanical Ventilator & its housing, Diesel cum store area (Loading-unloading area, parking area, Oxygen-DA cylinder storage area etc.) & suggest appropriate control measures. 9. Study and review surface features like workshop, subsidence area above underground workin gs, fan house, sub-station, explosive magazine, diesel storage and other material stores and ot her installations. 10. Study and review of existing Emergency Plan of the mine. 11. Study of all statutory permissions granted by the DGMS. 12. Workers’ participation in safety. 13. Mock rehearsals 14. Study the status of occupational safety and working-condition practices adopted by the workp ersons and management with reference to the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditi ons Code, 2020 and the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions (Central) Rules, 20 26; review the relevant records and documents; assess the level of statutory compliance; identi fy deficiencies, risks and gaps; and make appropriate recommendations for corrective and prev entive measures. 15. Extensive discussions with mine executives/officials. 16. Submission of recommendations and report. Annexure-II (Special Terms and Conditions) Special Terms & Conditions 1. The Party shall deploy a multidisciplinary audit team, including at least one Auditor having extensi ve and relevant experience in underground mining operations. The credentials, qualifications, and r elevant experience of all Auditor(s) deployed for the assignment shall be submitted along with the Audit Report for verification and record. 2. The Party shall submit two (02) coloured hard copies of the duly signed and completed Audit Repor t. . 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 6. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under.
